supersedes: Withdrawn b-multiple-values acceptance, not its retained historical execution
changes: MVC producers and descendants use four inline result words with demand-sized overflow independently of the final public output reservation
Literal MVC callable objects and environments use nonescaping stack storage, including relocation on tail transfer
Completed overflow buffers change owner without an intermediate caller-buffer copy; inline retirement copies at most four words and contiguous continuation publication copies once
Direct call and VALUES producers can target the continuation argument destination
Dynamic catch, block and cleanup retention transfers buffer ownership without a post-protected-form allocation
ordinary_calls: Remain direct internal calls with no public wrapper or extra argument copy. Two formerly unused continuation words now carry result mode and recipient metadata. Ordinary mode retains the existing output reservation and needs no temporary-result allocation.
public_results: Final public return counts are bounded by the caller-owned reservation. MVC producer counts are not bounded by that reservation. Runtime memory extents and the existing bounded source reader remain finite resources.
temporary_storage: Four inline words per indirect descriptor, with checked overflow arena storage under TCR tsp/base/limit. Inline retirement copies at most four words; overflow buffers transfer ownership. Free blocks are reused/coalesced and trailing storage reclaimed. The finite arena remains a checked resource, not a Lisp heap collector or complete native temp-stack implementation.
roots: 48-byte descriptors with four inline words or one owned arena buffer. Producer descriptors precede growing arguments. Direct delivery retires callee roots before writing and restores the surviving descriptor; root publication precedes scope release. Boundary observations check valid unique scanners and unchanged descriptor bytes. GC relocation and stack-object collection remain unqualified.
callables: Temporary outer callable and environment live on the stack. Captured variable cells and escaping inner closures remain heap objects. Their exact allocations are checked separately.
cost_oracle: Actual memory.copy invocations counted in a separately identified observation derivative. It executes the same copy instruction after reporting operands. The derivative is not sent to the production loader and does not support a timing claim.
control_independence: Native CCL, Python semantic model, literal region/ownership assertions, and an executed-copy oracle. Compiler mutants are author-written and separate from the producer path; external review remains required.
remaining: Claude review and renewed user acceptance before integration
Collector support for indirect temporary roots and stack callable objects
Production ownership-map admission of the temporary arena and general temp-stack integration
Condition class construction, signalling and handler dispatch
Host re-entry and exception payload relocation
Production adapter policy for final public output reservations
